episodes.title: Almost True
episodes.summary: A catastrophic event upends South Oxford. Sarah grows suspicious of the emergency response. While investigating, she encounters Zoë Boehm.

episodes.title: A Kind of Grief
episodes.summary: Zoë goes digging for answers as Sarah starts to spiral. Hamza is under pressure to keep a lid on the crisis.

episodes.title: Filthy Work
episodes.summary: Sarah winds up on an unexpected road trip. Zoë begins pulling threads left behind by Joe and suspects something bigger is at play.

episodes.title: My Friends Don't Like Me
episodes.summary: While hiding out, Sarah learns more about Downey. Zoë ruffles feathers as she seeks new collaborators for her investigation.

episodes.title: Slow Dying
episodes.summary: Zoë makes a startling discovery that expands the scale of the conspiracy. Sarah and Downey trek north, revealing their pasts along the way.

episodes.title: Neglected Waters
episodes.summary: A dangerous game of cat and mouse begins on the train to Scotland. Sarah and Zoë try piecing together Dinah's exact location.

episodes.title: Lights Go Out
episodes.summary: Downey and Amos converge as the race to find Dinah reaches a breaking point. Sarah must take a leap of faith.

episodes.title: What Will Survive
episodes.summary: Everything Sarah has fought for hangs in the balance.
